$comment: Lighthouse budgets (issue 236, NFR-PERF). scripts/lighthouse-run.mjs runs each route `runs` times on a mobile profile and checks the median run: a missed budget fails CI, a missed target is a warning. Since #271 (D328) performance 90 and TBT 200 ms are budgets; LCP fails above 3.5 s and 2.5 s stays the target (the lab floor is about 2.8 s on simulated slow 4G).
